_about: Test-only: real runs made by build_fixture.py with the API's own run code on the real bundles. Never imported by product code.

origin.title: A random real sample
origin.rule: 40 consecutive real SECOM units from the test block, the 313 units from 2008-10-02 21:32 to 2008-10-17 06:07 that the risk model never saw: units 144 to 183 of that block in time order (2008-10-07 11:16 to 2008-10-08 23:50). The first unit was drawn uniformly at random, with the run's seed, from the 274 possible windows. Every demo wafer of real WM-811K lot lot11911 (6 wafers), drawn uniformly at random from the 475 demo lots with at least two wafers. The demo set keeps the 379 lots the bundle's lot test flagged and 100 others drawn at random, so most lots carry a repeating pattern.…

result.method: PCA on 106 passing reference units and 437 sensors (reference-median imputation, autoscaling to reference mean and SD), keeping 56 components (90.1% of variance); Hotelling T2 limits from the Phase II F distribution and SPE limits by Box chi-square approximation matched to the mean and variance of leave-one-out reference SPE (reference rows <= features), at 99% and 99.9%. SPE contributions are the squared residuals of each sensor (they sum to SPE); T2 contributions are the complete decomposition z_j (P Lambda^-1 t)_j, which sums to T2 and can be negative for a sensor that pulls the score back.

rules: dead: never measured, or a single distinct value over the whole period

maintenance: a flatline window (at least 5 readings in a calendar week, all identical, with reference probability p_v ** n < 0.001); or a stuck value (a run of R >= 5 identical consecutive readings with n_readings * r ** (R - 1) < 0.01, r = the sensor's reference rate of repeating its previous reading, (repeats + 1) / (pairs + 2)); or a week missing at least 50% of readings while the reference misses at most 10%; or at least 20% of readings after the reference outside the reference range

watch: jumps (|robust z of a first difference| > 120.67, a threshold exceeded by 0.1% of reference differences) more frequent after the reference than the in-control share 0.100% allows (one-sided exact binomial test, Benjamini-Hochberg q <= 0.05); or a week missing at least 20% of readings while the reference misses at most 10%; or at least 5% of readings after the reference outside the reference range
result.method: EWMA (lambda 0.2, L 2.962, asymptotic limits (limits ±0.987)) and two-sided tabular CUSUM (k 0.5, h 5, both sums restart after a signal) on each leading sensor group's score: the sign-aligned mean of its members' FDC-standardised readings, standardised by the mean and SD of the 106 SECOM reference units. The charts start at zero at the first unit of this input. Sensor health applies the rules to this input's readings in time order and its 1 calendar week, against the same reference units.

result.method: Each map is resized to 64 x 64 by nearest neighbour (every cell copies a real cell: no die, pass or fail) and one-hot encoded; the deployed CNN (model.onnx, onnxruntime on CPU) gives logits, calibrated by temperature 0.5318. Unknown pattern: the smallest squared Mahalanobis distance of the L2-normalised embedding to a class mean (shared within-class, Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage, L2-normalised embeddings) is above 272.65, set to accept 95% of validation wafers; the energy score is a cross-check only. Auto-accepted: the top probability reaches 0.7693, the threshold set on validation for 99% precision. Spatial test: join count of rook-adjacent fail-fail die pairs against 999 random permutations of the fail labels over the wafer's dies (Cliff and Ord, 1981), seeded from the map itself (SHA-256 of its size and cells), so the same map always gets the same p-value; clustered when p < 0.05.

causes.framing: These are hypotheses to check, not diagnoses. Each row is a cause that open-access papers associate with a WM-811K defect pattern, quoted exactly with its location. The papers state these links briefly, mostly by citing older work; none was tested on this fab's data, and no source read gives direct experimental evidence for a pattern-to-cause link. Confidence rates the support in the literature read: medium = stated by two or more papers that cite different earlier sources; low = stated by one paper, or by an unreviewed preprint without a citation. High is not used.

result.method: Cosine similarity of the L2-normalised CNN embeddings, exact search over the 10253 real WM-811K demo wafers; an input that is itself a demo wafer never finds itself. Literature causes are listed for every pattern the model predicted in this run other than none: hypotheses to check, not a diagnosis.

Per lot of at least two wafers and per defect pattern, a one-sided binomial test P(X >= k) of the lot's count against the rate of that pattern among the wafers of the 1612 validation lots (36665 wafers, the deployed model's predictions), as the bundle's lot test; Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.05 over every lot and pattern tested in this run (the run is the family, so q-values depend on the lots submitted together); a lot is flagged when any of its patterns is. As in those reference rates, a wafer whose energy score is above -2.6177 counts as unknown, not as its predicted pattern; unknown counts are not tested, because the unknown-pattern score shown is Mahalanobis. Stacked map: per die position, the share of the lot's wafers whose die failed, when the wafers share one size.

result.summary: Of 40 units with a recorded result, 1 failed; the risk was above the threshold for 0 of them and for 2 units that passed. The predicted pattern matches the recorded WM-811K label on 5 of 5 wafers.

rules: dead: never measured, or a single distinct value over the whole period

maintenance: a flatline window (at least 5 readings in a calendar week, all identical, with reference probability p_v ** n < 0.001); or a stuck value (a run of R >= 5 identical consecutive readings with n_readings * r ** (R - 1) < 0.01, r = the sensor's reference rate of repeating its previous reading, (repeats + 1) / (pairs + 2)); or a week missing at least 50% of readings while the reference misses at most 10%; or at least 20% of readings after the reference outside the reference range

watch: jumps (|robust z of a first difference| > 120.67, a threshold exceeded by 0.1% of reference differences) more frequent after the reference than the in-control share 0.100% allows (one-sided exact binomial test, Benjamini-Hochberg q <= 0.05); or a week missing at least 20% of readings while the reference misses at most 10%; or at least 5% of readings after the reference outside the reference range
result.method: EWMA (lambda 0.2, L 2.962, asymptotic limits (limits ±0.987)) and two-sided tabular CUSUM (k 0.5, h 5, both sums restart after a signal) on each leading sensor group's score: the sign-aligned mean of its members' FDC-standardised readings, standardised by the mean and SD of the 106 SECOM reference units. The charts start at zero at the first unit of this input. Sensor health applies the rules to this input's readings in time order and its 1 calendar week, against the same reference units.
